'''Rip Calkin''', nicknamed "'''Iron One'''" was a famous [[Smashball/Legends|smashball]] center guard.

==Behind the scenes==
"Rip Calkin" is a near-anagram of "[[Wikipedia:Cal Ripken, Jr.|Cal Ripken]]," a famous [[Wikipedia:baseball|baseball]] player referred to by the nickname "Iron Man."
